en.holdHelp: Hold the shortcut in any app, speak, and let go: the clean text is pasted where the cursor is.

en.updateAvailableBody: Click to download it. On Mac, updates install on their own once the app is signed by Apple.
en.startIntro: A few steps and you can dictate in any app on this computer.
en.stepSignInHelp: Your zerosoft account transcribes and cleans up each dictation, and keeps the history.
en.stepAccessibilityHelp: In System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility, turn on zerosoft. It lets zerosoft paste the text into other apps; the shortcut works without it.
en.stepTryHelp: Click in the box, hold {key}, say a sentence and let go.
en.stepTryToggle: Or tap {key} once to start and again to finish.
en.modeBoth: Hold to talk, or tap once to start and again to finish
en.modeToggle: Only tap to start and stop
en.handsFreeHelp: A quick tap keeps listening until you tap again. Esc cancels.
en.restoreClipboard: Put back what was on the clipboard after pasting
en.voiceIntro: Saved in your zerosoft account: they also apply to dictation on the web.
en.cleanupHelp: Raw keeps what you said word for word, with only your dictionary replacements.
en.aiCleanup: Clean up with AI (punctuation, filler words, corrections and lists)
en.stylesHelp: Used when Cleanup is By app. zerosoft picks the kind of app from the one in front.
en.dictIntro: Names, brands and terms spelled your way, and words that should always be written differently. Shared with Voice on the web.
en.dictEmpty: No words yet. Add the names and terms Voice gets wrong.
en.histIntro: Your latest dictations, from this computer and from the web.
en.pasteHelp: Paste puts the text in the app you were using before opening this window.
en.histEmpty: No dictations yet. Hold {key} in any app to make the first one.
en.pendingHelp: Recorded without a connection or a session. Send them again when you are back: the text is copied and saved in your history.
en.lastLatency: Last dictation: {s} s from letting go of the keys to the text
en.offlineAccount: Cannot reach the server right now.
en.updatesAuto: New versions download in the background and install when you restart zerosoft.
en.updatesManual: This Mac build is not signed by Apple yet, so new versions do not install on their own. zerosoft tells you when one is out, and you get it from the download page.
en.errLoad: Could not load. Check your connection.
en.pasteNeedsAccessibility: Without Accessibility the text is copied and you paste it yourself with ⌘V.
en.shortcutTaken: Another app already uses this shortcut. Pick another one.
en.updatesOff: This build has no update signature: get new versions from the download page.
en.recordingIndicator: Show a small recording indicator on top of other apps while a meeting records and zerosoft is in the background
en.recordingIndicatorHelp: It shows the time and lets you open the meeting or stop the recording.
en.firstRunNotice: This window opened by itself because it is the first time zerosoft runs on this computer. It holds every setting of the desktop app. Open it again any time from {where}.
en.settingsWhereMac: the zerosoft icon in the menu bar › Settings, the zerosoft menu › Settings (⌘,), or your account menu in the app › Desktop app settings
en.settingsWhereWin: the zerosoft icon in the taskbar tray › Settings, Ctrl+, in the zerosoft window, or your account menu in the app › Desktop app settings
en.accessibilityUpdated: zerosoft was updated, and macOS keeps the Accessibility permission of the previous version even if the switch looks on. Click Reset permission, then turn zerosoft on again in the list.
en.accessibilityAdhoc: Is zerosoft already on in the list and this still says not allowed? That switch belongs to another build of zerosoft. Click Reset permission, then turn zerosoft on again.
en.accessibilityAdhocUpdates: This build is not signed with a fixed certificate yet, so macOS asks for Accessibility again after each update.
en.lastLatencyDetail: Server {server} s (transcription {tr} s, cleanup {cl} s). Upload and network {net} s. Paste {paste} s.
en.lastLatencyRules: Short sentence: cleaned up without AI so it arrives faster.
en.navSignIn: Sign in to see your account, workspace and app settings here.
en.navOffline: Your account and app settings need a connection.
en.kwGeneral: shortcut, dictation, hotkey, hands-free, clipboard, launch at login, version, update
en.kwPermissions: accessibility, microphone, camera, screen recording, privacy, reset permission
en.kwUpdates: update, version, check for updates, release, restart
en.kwAccount: sign in, sign out, server, self-host, account
en.accessibilityStaleAny: Is zerosoft already on in that list and this still says not allowed? macOS saved the permission for another copy of zerosoft (an older version, or one signed differently). Click Reset permission, then turn zerosoft on again in the list.
en.permIntro: What zerosoft can use on this Mac. If a switch is on in System Settings but here it says not allowed, the permission belongs to another copy of zerosoft: reset it and turn it on again.
en.permNotNeeded: Windows does not ask for these permissions: dictation, the microphone and the camera work without extra steps.
en.permCameraHelp: For video calls in Talk and screen recordings with your camera in Rec.
en.permScreenHelp: For screen recordings in Rec. macOS asks to restart zerosoft after you allow it.
en.permMicHelpFull: For dictation, meeting notes, calls and recordings.
en.meetingsIntro: Meetings record in the zerosoft window (Voice and Rec). While one records and zerosoft is in the background, a small black indicator with a red dot stays on top of other apps.
en.indicatorHowTo: Click it to open the meeting. Hover to see the time. Right-click to stop or hide it. Drag it anywhere: it stays where you leave it.
en.updateReadyLine: Version {v} is ready. Restart zerosoft to install it.
en.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again when you are online.
en.notCheckedYet: Not checked yet in this session.
en.tabSuspended: Asleep to save memory. Opens again when you click it.
en.tabsRestore: Reopen my windows and tabs when zerosoft starts
en.tabsSuspend: Put tabs I'm not using to sleep
en.tabsSuspendHelp: Frees memory. A paused tab stays in its place and loads again when you click it. A tab that's recording never pauses.
en.tabsLinks: {key}-click on a link opens it in
en.tabsKeys: New tab {t}, new window {n}, close {w}, reopen closed {r}, switch {k}.
